name: Talisman of Corruption
summary: In Darkshore, Xabraxxis uses the Talisman of Corruption to turn the Blackwood furbolgs against their former allies. The satyr keeps it in his personal pouch, where its magic binds the tribe to fel madness.

sections.title: A Conduit of Madness
sections.body: Auberdine's night elves have long sought the cause of the Blackwood furbolgs' turn against their former allies. Thundris Windweaver found that satyrs had brought about the tribe's fall. With talismans like this, demonic agents spread corrupting sorcery through the wilderness, tainting food and twisting peaceful forest spirits into frenzied beasts. The devices channel fel magic that grips the minds and wills of local tribes.

sections.title: Breaking the Grip
sections.body: To draw out Xabraxxis, you cleanse samples of the furbolgs' food with blessed moonwell water. The purification enrages the overseer. When Xabraxxis is slain, his demon bag yields the talisman. You bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine, where the Kaldorei can neutralize its foul emanations and study how to undo the demonic affliction in the forest.

faq.q: What is the Talisman of Corruption?
faq.answer: Xabraxxis uses the Talisman of Corruption to channel foul magic that corrupts the Blackwood furbolgs' minds and food in Darkshore.

aliases: where to find talisman of corruption
faq.answer: Xabraxxis, the satyr overseeing the northern Blackwood furbolg camp near the Cliffspring River, carries it in his demon bag.

faq.q: How do you draw out the owner of the talisman?
faq.answer: You gather the furbolgs' fruit, grain, and nuts, then combine them with moonwell water in a cleansing bowl. Place the offering by the bonfire near the river, and the cleansing enrages Xabraxxis until he attacks.

faq.q: What happens to the talisman after it is recovered?
aliases: who do i give the talisman to
faq.answer: You bring the talisman to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine. He secures it for disposal and studies how to free the furbolgs permanently from demonic corruption.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei of Auberdine, recovering the talisman helps free your ancestral furbolg allies from demonic degradation and heal the land.
As a druid, you see devices like the talisman as a perversion of the natural order. They twist sacred beasts into feral pawns of the Burning Legion's leftover minions.
